messages:
Elaine (People Ops): Quick heads up — Priya submitted her resignation today, last day 2026-05-20. I'm kicking off offboarding tasks: access sweep, license reclaim, exit interview, and benefits cutoff. Can IT/security/payroll/facilities confirm owning the items below?

Raj (Eng Manager): Thanks Elaine. I'll coordinate knowledge transfer sessions with the team this week. Can we keep her Slack for read-only until L+2? :calendar:

Theo (IT): I can run the account sweep and reclaim licenses. Proposing staged access removal:
1) Remove admin keys immediately (today)
2) Disable interactive login on last day (2026-05-20 18:00 PT)
3) Revoke service account tokens upon verification of KV handoff L+1

Maya (Security): Agreed with Theo. Please confirm whether there are any shared SSH keys or long-lived creds tied to Priya's name. If yes, rotate prior to L+1. I'll log the changes for audit.

Elaine (People Ops): Priya has two shared GitHub deploy keys and one GCP service account. Raj — can you confirm which repos still need her key?

Raj (Eng Manager): Repo list: inference-runtime, infra-deploy. I'll remove deploy key from infra-deploy by EOD. Leave inference-runtime until we finish the KV handoff.

Theo (IT): For tracking, here's the command I'll run to list sessions & tokens:
```
# quick audit
aws iam list-access-keys --user Priya || true
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --filter="user:priya@redwood.ai" || true
ssh-keyscan -t rsa github.com | grep -A2 priya
```
I'll paste the audit output into the offboard ticket when done.

Payroll Bot: Reminder — last payroll run will include final pay through 2026-05-20. Benefits termination effective 2026-05-20 23:59 PT. COBRA notice should go out within 14 days after termination. Please confirm home address for mailing.

Elaine (People Ops): Priya's mailing address is on her HR profile — I've confirmed with her. I'll draft COBRA notice and share in thread.

Facilities (Ops): Priya needs to return laptop and dongles. Drop-off window available 2026-05-21–2026-05-23 between 09:00–17:00. Keycard will be disabled 2026-05-21 09:00 unless Raj requests extension.

Priya (ex-employee): Thanks everyone — I can do a quick walkthrough with Raj on 5/19 for the KV migration. Will drop laptop at the office on 5/21 morning.

Maya (Security): Noted. We'll do a final credential sweep after Priya drops the laptop. Theo — please queue the service-account key rotation for 5/21 10:30 PT.

Theo (IT): Scheduled. I'll remove admin keys now and post the ticket link when complete.

Elaine (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Theo: run sweep + reclaim licenses, rotate service keys (DONE -> post ticket link)
- Raj: repo key removal + knowledge transfer 5/19
- Maya: audit log + final sweep 5/21 after asset return
- Payroll: COBRA notice within 14 days, confirm final payout
- Facilities: laptop/drop-off window 5/21–5/23
- Elaine: schedule exit interview (can we do 5/22 11:00 PT?).

Raj (Eng Manager): 5/19 walkthrough confirmed. Exit interview 5/22 11:00 PT works for me.

Theo (IT): Audit ticket: OFFBOARD-4821 created, admin keys revoked. I'll update with a list of reclaimed licenses and the timestamp when the service-account keys are rotated.

Maya (Security): I'll do the final audit and close the security checklist after keys rotated.

Elaine (People Ops): Thanks team — marking this thread as the canonical coordination stream. I'll update the offboard ticket with a summary once all items are closed. :white_check_mark:
